responsibility: Documents GCC's Link Time Optimization subsystem, including both the writer and reader sides of GIMPLE bytecode streaming. It explains slim versus fat LTO objects, the @code{all_lto_gen_passes} output pipeline, the @command{lto1} reader, WHOPR's LGEN/WPA/LTRANS stages, linker plugin and whole-program assumptions, IPA summary usage, LTO object-file layout, and the internal flags passed to @command{lto1}.
